page_sub: Hands-on AI workshops and thought leadership seminars delivered to professionals and students.

workshops.title: AI Workflow for Business Development
workshops.description: A practical workshop teaching business professionals how to integrate AI tools and automation into their workflows. Covered prompt engineering, AI assistants, and building lightweight AI-powered business processes.

workshops.title: Introduction to Generative AI
workshops.description: Foundational workshop on Generative AI for technical and non-technical audiences. Covered LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG systems, and practical use cases for GenAI in everyday professional work.

workshops.title: YOLO & Computer Vision — Hands-On
workshops.description: End-to-end hands-on workshop covering real-time object detection using YOLO. Participants built, trained, and evaluated their own CV models on custom datasets during the session.

seminars.title: AI & the Future of Jobs
seminars.description: An evidence-based talk exploring AI's impact on employment, the skills that will matter in an AI-driven economy, and how professionals can upskill strategically to thrive alongside intelligent systems.

seminars.title: How to Embrace AI — A Practical Guide
seminars.description: A mindset and strategy talk for students and early-career professionals on building an AI-augmented skillset, overcoming AI anxiety, and positioning oneself for the evolving tech ecosystem.

seminars.title: Building Agentic AI Systems
seminars.description: Technical seminar on the architecture of agentic AI — tool-using agents, memory systems, orchestration frameworks, and real-world deployment patterns for autonomous AI workflows.
